utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Rosa, the repair drive’s this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’ve been telling everyone so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Vik—that helps a lot; can you also remind folks to tell me by Friday if they need a small repair or can bring tools?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I’ll tell everyone to let you know by Friday if they need a small repair or can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Pia — let’s keep it simple: I’ll get there a little before 9 so we can sort the list and keep the drop-offs organized.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but I still want one clear public start time and a parking note so people aren’t circling the lot or arriving at random.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Fair enough, Pia — let’s say we start at 9 sharp, and we’ll have folks park by the east entrance at the community center lot so it stays orderly.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can get things started for the repair drive, but I can only stay a little while today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps—I’d only heard bits and pieces. Do you know if the kickoff’s still Saturday morning, and whether folks are still collecting tools?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: As far as I know, it’s still Saturday morning, and I think folks are still gathering tools. I can start setting things out when I get there, but I won’t be able to stay long.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, I’m a little scattered on it, but I think we’re still helping out this morning—if you know where they need me, I can head over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm where exactly they need you, and whether tools and transport are actually set for this morning?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think we were meeting by the community shed around 9, though Opal also told me 10 by the community center for the bike station, so I’d better check before I send you the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—Gus has the ladder and drills covered, so we mainly still need extra work gloves Saturday morning. Start with the shed roof first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright—I’ll ask around for spare work gloves and let Cleo know Saturday morning starts with the shed roof.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—if Cleo can bring gloves, that should cover the last gap. Be there Saturday morning and we’ll start on the shed roof.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still gathering tools and supplies, and I’m connecting the block association with a few other groups so turnout stays strong this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear—thanks for the update. Keep me posted if anything changes, and I’ll swing by once I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do—I’m syncing with a few groups this week, so I’ll let you know if we need anything specific before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll swing by Saturday morning with the ladder, drills, tape measure, and some screwdrivers so we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s a big help, Gus—thank you. I’m checking which Maple houses asked for help and whether the drill batteries are charged, then I’ll let Cleo know if we still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I'll make sure the batteries are topped off, and if Cleo still needs anything, I can probably toss in some extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, Mina — I’ll add a couple of hammers and a sturdy extension cord to the list and see what we can cover.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—how many open repair requests are we verifying today on Maple and Cedar, and what hours can I count on you for?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still confirming the Maple and Cedar counts, but I can be there from 9 to 1 to help verify and keep the supply list straight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Tess, I’ve got us starting at the community center lot, with the drop-off table by the east entrance—meet me there at 10 and I’ll get you pointed in the right direction.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Opal—I’ll be there at 10 by the east entrance, and I’ll keep spreading the word that folks can bring tools and spare parts over to the drop-off table.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Tess—that keeps it clean on my notes; we’re still starting at the community center lot, east entrance, at 10.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m still a little turned around on it, but if you’ve heard any update on the repair drive, let me know so I can keep up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah—Saturday at the community shed by noon, and if you know anyone handy, send them along; they could still use spare screws and extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, Saturday by noon at the community shed, got it. I’ll try to remember and pass along the bit about screws and extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll have the list ready, and we’ll start with the shed roof at 9 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—I can be there after drop-off, so 9 works well for me, and I can stay until about 2 before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Faye—that gives us a solid window, and we’ll focus on the shed roof first so we can make the most of your time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m coming in late again—once you tell me the time and place, I’ll help spread the word and pitch in when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I confirm anything, can we verify the latest list—what date and exact time do we have, is it definitely at the community center, and how many open repair requests are we counting across Maple and Cedar?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still catching up, so I don’t have the latest confirmed list yet—if Vik or Cleo has the current date, time, and request count, I can start spreading the word right after.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mara, from what I’m hearing the repair drive’s really gathering momentum—people have been dropping off tools and spare parts all afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s wonderful to hear—Jules is lining up more volunteers too, and I’ve already asked Cleo to check on a couple of hammers and a sturdy extension cord so we can fill the last gaps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Mara—between Jules’s volunteers and Cleo checking on those last few things, it sounds like we’re in really good shape for this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Jules, start with the porch rail on Maple, then the two leaky faucets Mrs. Alvarez mentioned. After that, swing by the loose gate at the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—that gives us a clear order, and I’ll also see who from the other groups can cover pieces of it so we keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—keep it moving and let me know fast if anyone needs extra parts or a hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, so just send me a quick update if anything changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm whether the tools and transport are actually lined up yet, or are we still just assuming they’ll be there?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Last I had, we still needed a couple ladders, a power drill, and extra work gloves, so I wouldn’t assume it’s all lined up yet. If you hear anything solid on transport, send me a quick update while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Leo, I’m happy to help with the repair drive as long as it’s between school drop-off and pickup—mid-morning to early afternoon is usually best for me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works—Saturday mid-morning is good. We’re starting with the leaking shed roof, so if you can, bring extra work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Saturday mid-morning works for me, and I’ll bring extra work gloves. I just need to head out in time for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got the list started, and we’ll make the leaking shed roof our first job at 9 on Saturday. I’ll bring the ladder and tarps so we can get right to it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but I need to know where people should park and who’s handling any heavy hauling before we tell everyone to show up at 9.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Good point—I’ll add parking details to the list tonight and make sure we’ve got a couple of folks lined up for the heavy hauling before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, I think we’re meeting by the community center at 10, then heading to the bike station first—can you remind me if I’m mixing anything up?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You’ve got it mostly right—it’s this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’ve been telling everyone so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the parking lot, Saturday, 10 to 2. Thanks, Vik; I’ll try to keep that straight and pass it along if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m coming in late again, Eli, but I can still help spread the word and pitch in when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s fine, Dane — just come to the community shed a little before 9 if you can, and we’ll keep the list clear so it all runs smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll head to the community shed just before 9 if I can, and I’ll keep spreading the word in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll swing by early Saturday with the ladder and drills, and I can toss in the tape measure and extension cords too if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, so it is Saturday then—do you know if folks are still collecting tools and spare parts too, or is Quinn mostly set now?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: As far as I know they’re still collecting, so I’d bring whatever spare tools or parts you can. I’m still planning to roll up early Saturday with the ladder and drills.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I act on that, can you confirm the latest count of open repair requests for Maple and Cedar together, and which tools and supplies we’ve actually verified on hand?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I can’t honestly confirm that right now—I’ve gotten a bit turned around on the latest numbers and what’s been checked. Let me double-check with the others before you act on it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah—please confirm the combined open-request count for Maple and Cedar, plus the verified tools and supplies on hand, and then we can move forward.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need shingles for the roof and two working drills, and I’m short on gloves too—if Quinn can cover any of that, I’ll mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word right away and ask around for shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves, and I’ll send anyone who can help your way at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thank you—if you hear numbers or firm offers on any of those, send them over and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m checking around for the extra drills and gloves now, and if shingles are still the sticking point I can chip in to help cover them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey—that helps a lot. I’ve still got us starting at the community center lot with the drop-off table by the east entrance, so bring the drills and gloves there first if you find them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I’ll bring anything I can round up to the east entrance first, and I’ll let Cleo know right away if I strike out on the shingles.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can come by and get a few things started for the repair drive, just not for very long today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That helps a lot, Uli—if you can, please start with checking what basic tools and supplies we still need, and I’ll slot you in where it saves the most time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, Rosa—I’ll start by checking the tools and supplies, and I’ll stay as long as I can today.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help spread the word, Mara, but let’s make sure we tell people it’s 10 on Saturday at the community lot by the tool shed, with overflow parking on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Pia—that’s exactly what I’ll share: 10 on Saturday at the community lot by the tool shed, with overflow parking on Maple. I’m also still checking which Maple houses asked for help and whether the drill batteries are charged before we lock in the work list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that’s the right idea—I just don’t want us promising too much until the batteries, tools, and hauling for anything bulky are actually confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Cleo said we still need shingles, two working drills, and more gloves, so I’m asking around quietly to see who can cover what.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks for checking, Rey — I’ve been telling folks the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, so I’ll mention we still need shingles, two working drills, and more gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps a lot. I know Gus can bring a drill and sawhorses, and I’ll keep asking around for another drill, extra gloves, and maybe a little help with shingles if nobody has them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I lock anything in, can you confirm the date, location, and exact list of open requests we’re verifying today?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still confirming the final details, but it’s the repair drive we’re organizing for this weekend, and we’re still collecting tools, screws, spare parts, plus basics like gloves and tape. I can message Mara and the other groups now so I can get you the date and location pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—please do that, and while you’re at it, can you also confirm which houses on Maple and Cedar still have open repair requests and what tools we already have on hand?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Bo, I heard the repair drive’s really coming together—Friday after school pickup is the best time to bring tools or spare parts by, and they could still use spare screws and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good to know—Friday after pickup works, and spare screws plus extension cords sound like the main gaps. I still think the drive itself is Saturday at the community center, but I’d double-check the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That matches what I’ve been hearing—I’ll keep telling folks Friday after pickup for drop-offs, and I’ll double-check the Saturday time at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, bring the drill, screwdrivers, and tape measure—what time can you get to the repair drive, and how long can you stay?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can get there early, around 8, and stay through the early afternoon if that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: 8 works. Give me a firm cutoff—what time are you leaving in the early afternoon so I can plan around you?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Opal, I’m finalizing the list now—we’re starting with the porch rail on Maple, then Mrs. Alvarez’s faucets, and after that the community garden gate.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Rosa—Maple porch rail first, then Mrs. Alvarez’s faucets, then the community garden gate; I’ve got the order marked down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Opal—if you hear of any other neighbors who need small fixes, send them my way before we lock the list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can get things started for the repair drive and stay a little while, just not too long today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, that helps a lot—I'm still a little turned around on it, so getting it started would be great.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll go ahead and set things up, then, and you can jump in once you’re ready. I just need to head out a bit later today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Ira, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—Saturday at the community shed by noon. If you can come by, please do, and let anyone else know too; they could also use spare screws and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks for the heads-up—I’m out running errands, but keep me posted on how the repair drive’s coming along, and I’ll pass along the note about screws and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do—I’ll keep you posted, and thanks for helping spread the word while you’re out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, I’m a little fuzzy on the full plan, but Opal said to meet by the community center at 10 and start at the bike station.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren, but I’ve already lined us up for 9 on Saturday and we’re starting with the shed roof first—I’ll bring the list, ladder, and tarps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, thanks for straightening me out, Sam. I’ll be there at 9 on Saturday, and I’ll bring my toolbox this time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need shingles for the roof, two working drills, and more gloves for the repair drive—if you can cover any of that, I’ll mark it on my list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can ask around for gloves and maybe a working drill, but I’d need to drop things off after school pickup on Friday if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Friday after school pickup works fine—if you can confirm the gloves and possibly one drill by then, I’ll mark that down and keep looking for the shingles and the second drill.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before we call it a real drive, can you confirm who’s actually bringing the tools and how the heavy stuff’s getting moved?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus is bringing the ladders and drills Saturday morning, and Sam’s helping on the shed first. For the heavy stuff, we’ll hand-carry what we can and use the ladder setup at the shed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm whether Gus is definitely covering enough tools for everyone, and who’s handling anything too heavy to hand-carry?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
